column1: # Remote entries are downloaded by scripts/fetch-external-corpus.sh.
# Local entries (url starting with local:) are committed under tests/fixtures/corpus.
# Tier A — generated fixtures committed in tests/fixtures/corpus
# Rejected candidates, kept here so the same file is not evaluated twice:
# foal_by_douglas_repetto.hpgl: the pen stays down across PA moves and the importer only draws coordinates given to PD/PU, so it imports no objects
# bird_by_brian_whitman_and_kelly_dobson.hpgl: same pen-down PA drawing style, plus unsupported EP/PG commands, so it imports no objects
# Controller.hpgl: same pen-down PA drawing style after IP/SC page setup, so it imports no objects
# hatch_as_multipolygon.dxf: one HATCH entity and no outline entity the importer supports, so it imports no objects
# bug1028735.pdf: text and images only, so it has no vector paths to import
# blendmode.pdf: text and images only, so it has no vector paths to import
# annotation-border-styles.pdf: text and images only, so it has no vector paths to import
